added_columns.Street address: Published street and number, or PO Box. Empty if not found.
added_columns.City: Published town or city; not inferred
added_columns.ZIP code: Text preserving leading zero; five digits or ZIP+4, or empty
added_columns.Full address: Address formatted from published components, or empty
added_columns.Address type: Distinguishes property / business contact, office, PO Box, arrival point, partial address, and out-of-state contacts
added_columns.Address source URL: Public source supporting the selected address
added_columns.Address notes: Missing components, conflicting sources, multiple properties or location caveats
added_columns.Description source URL: Source website or listing page for the collected description; Unknown if not collected
added_columns.Missing required fields: Semicolon-separated shortages. Complete requires a physical Maine address verified on the official website, four property photographs, and a collected source description.

image_names: ID-cover.ext, ID-000.ext, ID-001.ext, ID-002.ext; optional ID-logo.ext
address_evidence: address-manifest.json; per-record evidence under logs/addresses; saved source pages and search results under cache
